yt-pipeline.name: yt-pipeline
yt-pipeline.purpose: Run a full YouTube research pipeline: search for videos, ingest them into NotebookLM, conduct multi-pass analysis inside NotebookLM, and save a structured Obsidian research document. Supports fresh search, corpus augmentation with specific URLs, analysis refinement, and single-source deep reading with faithful reconstruction, core frameworks, and integrated commentary. For one source, requests containing triggers like 全面, 完整, 逐字, or 逐词 should also append a full transcript and the intermediate NotebookLM working passes in the same output document. Transcript retrieval for comprehensive single-source runs should be delegated to the yt-transcript skill, which handles provider fallback and completeness checks. Semantic work should remain inside NotebookLM; local code is limited to orchestration, ingestion, state management, and markdown rendering. This manifest describes version 1.1 of the skill behavior.
trigger_phrases: find and analyze YouTube content on
add this video to my research
what did those videos say about
给我这条视频的完整逐字稿和分析

security.reason: Calls YouTube and Google NotebookLM APIs and writes research documents to raw/; external side effects.

yt-transcript.name: yt-transcript
yt-transcript.purpose: Fetch a YouTube transcript with deterministic fallbacks and completion checks. First try yt-dlp subtitles, then youtube-transcript-api, then direct YouTube caption metadata, and finally OpenAI audio transcription with chunked verification. Use when a user wants the full transcript of a known YouTube URL, when yt-dlp subtitles are missing or incomplete, or when another skill such as yt-pipeline needs a best-effort transcript plus metadata about completeness.
trigger_phrases: get the transcript of this YouTube video
extract subtitles from this YouTube URL
如果 yt-dlp 不行就用 openai-audio-transcribe
检查这条 YouTube 字幕是否完整

security.reason: Reads from YouTube and may call OpenAI transcription; writes only inside the local skill directory for helper runtime bootstrapping.
